title: ScopeBench: Do Agents Preserve Engagement Boundaries Under Goal Pressure?
description:
arXiv:2609.30325v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agents are increasingly deployed with real autonomy in web application and network penetration testing, where a single out-of-scope action can breach a client's engagement boundary. Existing offensive-security benchmarks measure raw hacking capability; as those benchmarks saturate, the real barrier to deployment is a special case of alignment: scope adherence.
